basic_info.description: This extensively remodeled residence boasts soaring ceilings, massive sliding glass doors opening to private terraces and garden.  The main floor is massive, with separate dining, living and sitting areas.  The chef's kitchen includes a large island, Fisher & Paykel appliances, two-tone cabinetry, Krion countertops with bar-top seating.  All three bedrooms are on one level and each include en-suite bathrooms with copious closet space. Residence features underfloor heating, in-unit laundry and way too many features to describe.  Most see to believe! Great SFR alternative and ready for fast-track condo conversion.
